title: trinia glauca subsp. carniolica
intro: Trinia glauca subsp. carniolica, commonly known as Alpine Trinia, is a plant species in the carrot family. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to support digestive health and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal issues such as diarrhea and dyspepsia. The health benefits of Alpine Trinia include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing digestive discomfort and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Trinia glauca subsp. carniolica include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
